svg.title: The body map along the cortical strip, unrolled from the top of the brain to its side: genitalia, toes, feet, ankle, knee, leg, hip, trunk, shoulder, elbow and wrist in small areas, then a large hand region (hand, digits V to II, thumb), then neck, brow, eyelids and eyeballs, then a large face-and-lips region, then jaw, tongue, throat, mastication and salivation.
